x-formats.name: ImageJ TIFF
x-formats.carries: ImageJ reads voxel size, origin and value calibration in classic TIFF. Bio-Formats reads voxel size in classic and BigTIFF.

x-formats.name: OME-TIFF
x-formats.carries: Bio-Formats reads voxel sizes. Classic ImageJ and ITK read the in-plane sizes.

x-formats.name: TIFF slices
x-formats.carries: ImageJ, Bio-Formats and ITK read the in-plane pixel size.

x-formats.name: Raw
x-formats.carries: The adjacent JSON record gives axes, units and value scaling.

x-formats.name: MetaImage
x-formats.carries: ITK and VTK read spacing and origin. The header stores lengths without a unit.

x-formats.name: AmiraMesh
x-formats.carries: Bio-Formats reads voxel size and assumes micrometers when the unit is unknown. The bounding box records placement.

x-formats.name: NeXus NXdata
x-formats.carries: silx reads physical coordinates and stored samples. The signal's offset and scaling factor recover physical values.

x-formats.name: OME-Zarr 0.5
x-formats.carries: ome-zarr-py reads the axes, voxel size and origin of every level. The tomojax attribute holds value scaling.

Seeded.title: Seeded
Seeded.description:
The voxels connected to the seeds whose value stays near the value at the seeds.

    The level is the median around each seed, averaged over seeds. ``tolerance`` is in
    units of the local noise or, with ``tolerance_unit="value"``, of the source.
    ``smoothing`` is a Gaussian sigma in voxels applied first, for very noisy data; it
    pulls the edges in. ``max_radius`` limits growth to that many index units from the
    nearest seed.

Band.title: Band
Band.description:
Voxels whose signed distance from a feature lies in (inner, outer] index units.

    Voxels beyond the array are background. Inside the feature the signed distance
    is one minus the Euclidean distance to the nearest background voxel center,
    so a face neighbor of background has distance zero. Outside the feature it
    is the distance to the nearest feature voxel center. Both bands stop at the grid.
